mutation.operation: replace the second name byte with an embedded NUL

acceptanceScope: One CArchive entry with an embedded NUL in its name is rejected by the isolated PyInstaller analyzer after cookie screening.
limits: One generated Linux x86-64 PyInstaller artifact.
Does not cover other malformed fields, obfuscated archives, or other archive formats.
Does not cover browser ingestion, PostgreSQL persistence, queued workers, or project-level recovery.
Does not establish broad malformed-input accuracy or reconstruction fidelity.
